vision_requirements_in_scope: real-time factor for live and offline paths
peak resident memory and CPU utilization
comparison with at least one conventional baseline on the same hardware

vision_requirement_out_of_scope.end_to_end_frame_latency_distribution: Host capture-call-to-workspace and nominal-latency estimates are retained, but a true CoreAudio ADC-onset timestamp is not available through the current blocking read path and remains open.

offline_protocol.baseline: fixed threshold saliency, nearest frequency prototype, bounded deque
offline_protocol.fairness: identical preconstructed AudioFrame objects and identical timing/tracemalloc instrumentation in one process

interpretation_rules: A simpler conventional baseline is a resource floor, not a capability-equivalent competitor; Cora is not required to outperform it.
Peak RSS is the process-lifetime high-water mark sampled at operation end, not operation-attributable incremental memory.
PortAudio overflow flags are the dropped-frame proxy; absence of a flag is not a hardware transport proof.
Strict 25 ms deadline misses are reported separately from the frozen 30 ms operational limit.
No energy-efficiency claim is allowed because power is not measured.
No device-onset or hard-real-time claim is allowed from host monotonic call boundaries or nominal backend latency.
